summary: Strengthen respondent-bank due diligence, payment oversight and relationship decisions. Explore the correspondent banking course and its practical curriculum.
lede: Correspondent banking training helps banking, payment and trade-finance professionals assess and oversee respondent-bank relationships. Participants practice building due-diligence files, assessing relationship risk and ownership information, reviewing trade-finance red flags and payment transparency, and documenting alert escalation. The course uses FATF Recommendation 13 and the Wolfsberg CBDDQ as reference points, with work on de-risking decisions and ongoing review planning.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who assess or oversee correspondent relationships, cross-border payment flows and trade-finance exposure.
audience: Fintech and Payment Service Provider Compliance Leads
prerequisites: Prior working knowledge of AML, KYC and sanctions controls is expected. No programming is required; the course focuses on relationship assessment, governance and decision documentation.
